integrity: Proof is analytical and self-contained; rational checks are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed smooth two-control one-dimensional HJB coefficients; one interior P1 degree of freedom; two specified quadrature assembly conventions and exact arithmetic. The common discrete solution is at a policy tie. No universal statement about strictly complementary cases, nonlinear PDE solutions or numerical stopping tests.
title: Arbitrarily small matched-order quadrature changes cause exact policy cycles in a one-node HJB finite element method
